v1.2.5g (24 July 2022) |feed_title = Independence Day |previous_update = [[v1.2.4]] |next_update = [[v1.3.0|Polluted Wasteland II Update]] }} __TOC__ ==Description== '''v1.2.5''' is the thirty-ninth update to be released on Tower Defense Simulator, on the 4th of July 2022. It introduced the modifier system into the game and made various small quality of life improvements. This version encompassed eight updates, the main v1.2.5 update (released 4 July 2022), and seven minor updates, the v1.2.5a (released 5 July 2022), v1.2.5b (released 6 July 2022), v1.2.5c (released 10 July 2022), v1.2.5d (released 14 July 2022), v1.2.5e (released 15 July 2022), v1.2.5f (released 23 July 2022) and v1.2.5g (released 24 July 2022). ==Additions== *[[Modifiers]] **[[Fireworks]] Modifier **[[Cowboy (Modifier)|Cowboy]] Modifier **[[Space Suit]] Modifier **[[Scuba Gear]] Modifier **[[HP Locked]] Modifier **[[Double Health]] Modifier ==Removals== *"Exit" arrow marker *"Entrance" arrow marker ==Changes & Bugfixes== *[[Firework]] emote is now purchasable for {{Robux|250}}. *[[Badlands]] now has the [[Cowboy (Modifier)|Cowboy]] modifier. *[[Moon Base]] now has the [[Space Suit]] modifier. *[[Abyssal Trench]] now has the [[Scuba Gear]] modifier. *[[Retro Zone]] no longer has a pink hue in one of the corners of the map. *[[Toyboard]] is now brighter. *[[Winter Abyss]] no longer has a blue haze. *Time before a match starts is 30 seconds when not everyone has voted, but after everyone voted and the timer is higher than 20 seconds, it will instantly change to 20 seconds. **In a solo match, the timer is instantly set to 20 seconds the moment you vote. *Intermission time between waves is now shorter. *Skip wave button now appears one second earlier on all modes. *On the "TRIUMPH!" and "YOU LOST" screens, [[Hardcore Mode|Hardcore]] mode is now referred to as "Hardcore" instead of "Survival". *All maps have the [[Fireworks]] modifier enabled to celebrate 4th of July. *Fixed wave timer getting stuck on 1 second. *Fixed wave timer starting one second later than it should. :In '''v1.2.5a''': *Fixed wave bonus rewarding wrong amounts of {{Money|Cash}}. *Fixed not getting towers when purchased in the store. *Fixed map name not appearing on the ''Triumph'' screen. *Fixed [[Fallen King (Legacy)|Fallen King]] not spawning on Wave 40 in [[Fallen Mode|Fallen]] mode. *Intermission timer now starts at 00:05 instead of 00:04 and ends at 00:01 instead of 00:00. **The time between waves is still the same. *Arrows are no longer doubled at the beginning of a match. :In '''v1.2.5b''': *[[Fireworks]] modifier is now disabled on all maps. :In '''v1.2.5c''': *[[Firework]] emote gamepass taken offsale. :In '''v1.2.5d''': *Lobby updated due to Tower Defense Simulator being nominated in the Bloxies. :In '''v1.2.5e''': *Corrected a typo on the announcements board, "SImulator" is now "Simulator". :In '''v1.2.5f''': *All maps have the [[Cowboy (Modifier)|Cowboy]] modifier enabled to celebrate the National Day of the Cowboy. :In '''v1.2.5g''': *[[Cowboy (Modifier)|Cowboy]] modifier is now disabled on all maps. ==Gallery== {{Gallery|Open = Yes|
